findings.issue: Platform runs the format check synchronously at upload completion; a content/type mismatch returns 422 FILE_POLICY_REJECTED from /completion and no file is created. The page first showed the generic server reason, which reads like a type/size problem.
findings.handling: Fixed in web: a 422 at the completion step now says the content failed the check and no file was created (key file.upload.issue.contentRejected), server reason appended; unit test added. AC-06 rerun PASS.

findings.issue: React warning <button> nested in <button> from the address copy control (antd copyable icon rendered as Button).
findings.handling: Fixed: copy icons are plain text spans, Open is a link. Upload page no longer emits the warning (probe). The same warning still appears on the File Records detail page (existing PublicUrlBar, not part of this change).

findings.issue: Recent Uploads Actions column was clipped at 1440px.
findings.handling: Column widths reduced; fits at 1440 (rerun screenshot).

findings.issue: FILE_UPLOAD_READ alone cannot reach the page: parent menu 562 'Platform Settings' is bound to 900000000000000534 GATEWAY_CONFIG_READ, which also shows API Routes. APIs work with FILE_UPLOAD_READ alone (constraints/list 200, start 403).
findings.handling: AC-04 verified with FILE_UPLOAD_READ + 534 (same approach as block 130/134 acceptance). Needs a main-session decision.

findings.issue: Login endpoint rate limit (429) after many sign-ins; AC-04 first attempt failed on login.
findings.handling: Script retries login after 30 s; AC-04 rerun PASS.

findings.issue: Local i18n manifest publishes no locale, so zh-CN cannot be selected.

notes.AC-05 onlyMine: All uploads in the window were made by the admin, so the Only Mine list equals the full list (request returned 200 and the uploaded file stays visible); it does not demonstrate filtering out other people's files.
notes.AC-01 publicUrl: Anonymous GET via urllib without any credentials; certificate verification disabled for the local self-signed MinIO.
notes.AC-03 snapshot: configured=false was observed on the first poll after the route DELETE (0 s), so no 35 s wait was needed; restore via stage5_setup.py, configured=true afterwards, operations-console-bff/PRIVATE (CARD_BIN_CSV) unchanged.
notes.artifacts: Uploads created by the runs (stage5-logo-*.png, one probe-*.png) remain in mor_platform_v2e2e / MinIO public bucket; synthetic roles and accounts deleted via IAM (204).
